passage.title: Sam's Train Ride
sentences: On Saturday, Sam and Grandma Rose took the train to Bay City.
The train left at nine o'clock.
Sam sat by the window and looked at the boats.
In Bay City, they went to the train museum.
Sam's favorite engine was a big green one from 1920.
He took a photo of it for his map wall.
They got home at four o'clock.

items.prompt: Where did Sam and Grandma Rose go?
items.explain: They went to the train museum in Bay City.

items.prompt: What time did the train leave?
items.explain: The train left at nine o'clock.

items.prompt: Why did Sam take a photo of the green engine?
options: It was for a school test
items.explain: The green engine was his favorite, so he took a photo of it.

passage.title: Priya's Rover Test
sentences: After school on Tuesday, Priya tested her rover in the gym.
The rover had four wheels and a small camera.
The rover rolled forward, then it stopped.
Priya plugged the battery in to charge.
Ten minutes later, she tried again.
This time the rover rolled across the whole gym.
Priya smiled and wrote the result in her notebook.

items.prompt: Where did Priya test her rover?
items.explain: She tested it in the gym.
The battery light was red, so the battery was low.

items.prompt: How did Priya feel at the end?
items.explain: She smiled, so she was pleased.
